title: How to use the handwriting notebook

blocks.text: How to use the handwriting notebook

Soft pencil, printed pages 100%. The lines are written from right to left . The dark line is the basic line; the high dotted line indicates the height of the alife, the low line indicates the limit of the letters descending below the line. For each letter: look at the black model, review the gray shapes by saying name and sound, then write the empty line to memory. Track the whole body first, then the stitches and vowels. The horizontal indent (as in ⁧بـ⁩ ) shows which way the letter connects.
